script_text: Stop, Leo — Jupiter is parked in your own sign and Pluto just flipped your relationship axis. Your ruling Sun, burning through Scorpio's 4th House of Home, pushes you to reclaim your space, while bold Jupiter, visiting your sign just once a year, expands your 1st House of Identity and feeds your Fire element a genuine second wind. Meanwhile Pluto in Aquarius throws a hard opposition across your 7th House of Partnerships, and Uranus in Gemini fires a surprise sextile into your 11th House of Gains. In love, a power struggle over commitment surfaces today; if you're attached, choose honesty over pride. Singles, watch your 11th House circle — someone unexpected appears with real potential. Career-wise, Mercury in Sagittarius sharpens your 5th House, so pitch that idea now; a bonus lands. Avoid co-signing loans while Saturn lingers in your 8th. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
